#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /qualification
mkdir -p transfer-initial
mv direct rebuilt installed-current installed-rebuilt smoke-direct.json smoke-rebuilt.json serde-direct.xml serde-rebuilt.xml build-direct.log build-rebuilt.log transfer-initial/
find current original -name '._*' -type f -delete
CIBUILDWHEEL=1 uv build --python env/bin/python --no-build-isolation current --wheel --sdist --out-dir direct > build-direct.log 2>&1
CIBUILDWHEEL=1 uv build --python env/bin/python --no-build-isolation direct/*.tar.gz --wheel --out-dir rebuilt > build-rebuilt.log 2>&1
uv pip install --python env/bin/python --no-deps --target installed-current direct/*.whl > install-current.log 2>&1
uv pip install --python env/bin/python --no-deps --target installed-rebuilt rebuilt/*.whl > install-rebuilt.log 2>&1
uv pip install --python env/bin/python --no-deps --reinstall direct/*.whl > install-env.log 2>&1
uv pip install --python env-rebuilt/bin/python --no-deps --reinstall rebuilt/*.whl > install-env-rebuilt.log 2>&1
PYTHONPATH=/qualification/installed-current env/bin/python current/tests/tooling/runtime/json_acceleration.py --json > smoke-direct.json
PYTHONPATH=/qualification/installed-rebuilt env/bin/python current/tests/tooling/runtime/json_acceleration.py --json > smoke-rebuilt.json
PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m pytest current/tests/suites/product/serde -c current/pyproject.toml --require-extra serde -q --junitxml=serde-direct.xml > serde-direct.log 2>&1
PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env-rebuilt/bin/python -m pytest current/tests/suites/product/serde -c current/pyproject.toml --require-extra serde -q --junitxml=serde-rebuilt.xml > serde-rebuilt.log 2>&1
PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m bench.profiles.jsonx_throughput --compare-source installed-original --source installed-current --require-native --include records-1k --rounds 9 --repetitions 5 --output historical-current-clean-locked.json > historical-current-clean-locked.log 2>&1
PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m bench.profiles.jsonx_throughput --compare-source installed-current --source installed-rebuilt --require-native --include records-1k --rounds 9 --repetitions 5 --max-slowdown 1.15 --output wheel-sdist-clean-locked.json > wheel-sdist-clean-locked.log 2>&1
commands.historical_profile: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m bench.profiles.jsonx_throughput --compare-source installed-original --source installed-current --require-native --include records-1k --rounds 9 --repetitions 5 --output historical-current-clean-locked.json
commands.packaging_profile: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m bench.profiles.jsonx_throughput --compare-source installed-current --source installed-rebuilt --require-native --include records-1k --rounds 9 --repetitions 5 --max-slowdown 1.15 --output wheel-sdist-clean-locked.json

followup_decode_profile: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=/qualification/current env/bin/python -m bench.profiles.jsonx_throughput --compare-source installed-original --source installed-current --require-native --include loads --rounds 9 --repetitions 5 --output historical-loads.json
notes: Full test subprocesses use real venv site-packages; initial --target-only setup was corrected before retained test results.
Timing compares serial alternating isolated workers on the same busy shared host; absolute cross-hardware latency equality is not claimed.

Initial latest-backend transfer included AppleDouble metadata; final source directories and rebuilt direct/sdist wheels were cleaned before primary locked tests and profiles. Initial timings/receipt are preserved separately and real source bytes did not change.

Locked same-revision packaging latency gate failed on the shared busy host; the raw failures are retained. Matching .text/.rodata and Python bytes establish identical installed codec code, while this run does not establish a 15% wall-time bound under contention.

One protocol improvement then used two persistent workers alternating each case in short blocks, rather than timing whole variant stages. All21 locked packaging cases passed the unchanged1.15 threshold, worst observed slowdown9.94%; earlier whole-stage failures remain retained. This bounds this measured fixture set and host run, not every payload or hardware.

Final source comparison:19/21 exact. Concurrent unrelated container acceleration changes hatch_build.py and pyproject.toml only by adding _sorted_native and its wheel-test extra/import. Removing exactly those additions reproduces qualified hashes; JSON source/build recipe/flags are unchanged. Qualification predates those additions.
